91e91c955650afaf98e4acebee060a58ac99ade5.name: Lithium 0.26.1 for Fabric
91e91c955650afaf98e4acebee060a58ac99ade5.changelog:
Lithium 0.26.1 for Minecraft 26.3.x fixes two critical issues.

Make sure to take a backup of your world before using the mod and please report any bugs and mod compatibility issues at the [issue tracker](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/lithium-fabric/issues). You can check the [description of each optimization](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/lithium/blob/mc26.3-0.26.1/lithium-mixin-config.md) and how to disable it when encountering a problem.

## Changes
- Fix F3+1 profiler crash
- Disable optimization that causes chunk corruption

435ad0289209bb72195e7a423756a03f5dfa5a9a.name: Lithium 0.25.3 for Fabric
435ad0289209bb72195e7a423756a03f5dfa5a9a.changelog:
Lithium 0.25.3 for Minecraft 26.2.x fixes a few issues.

Make sure to take a backup of your world before using the mod and please report any bugs and mod compatibility issues at the [issue tracker](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/lithium-fabric/issues). You can check the [description of each optimization](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/lithium/blob/mc26.2-0.25.3/lithium-mixin-config.md) and how to disable it when encountering a problem.

## Fixes
- Fix player standing on sculk sensor not waking the sculk sensor
- Fix furnace not waking when fuel slot is modified with /item command
